in_marathi.name: Devesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God, deity, lord

The name Devesh signifies the presence of a divine being, a lord or protector. The name is also associated with nature and the elements, as Deva is the god of the heavens and the sky in Hindu mythology.
